Is the change minimal and confined to what the root cause requires (no product change if the cause is test measurement; no test weakening if the cause is product)?

Are the misleading comments (spec comment claiming the dispatcher never processes own-send; stale ChatStoreContext header) corrected where they caused the misdiagnosis, without rewriting governing specs beyond what is factually wrong?
Do the remaining groups-dispatch-isolation tests and the full unit suite pass, with no new lint/type errors?
